title: Filter: exclude list
description: Packages filter/rules.ts's auto rules miss but shouldn't be in the catalog — force-excludes a real library/support package that happens not to match any noise pattern.

sources.description: PackageSourceId values (<format>-<provider>, e.g. "pacman-aur") this exact name has actually been checked on — not a wildcard across every source, since the same name can mean something else entirely elsewhere.

name.description: The exact SourcedPackage.name on every listed source.

reason.description: Why this isn't a real app/game despite passing the auto rules — required so the exception is auditable later, not just an unexplained line.
